newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Suharto says number of poor Indonesians falls.
newsitem.headline: Suharto says number of poor Indonesians falls.

text.p: The number of Indonesians living below the poverty line had dropped to around 11 percent of the population in 1996 from about 14 percent in 1993, President Suharto said on Monday.
Unveiling his 1997/98 budget speech to parliament, he said a national survey last year showed the total number of poor was around 22 million in a total population of some 200 million.
This compared to close to 26 million people living below the poverty line in 1993.
He said the number of poor in rural areas had dropped to around 15 million, or 12 percent of the rural population, from 17 million or almost 14 percent in 1993.
There were more than six million urban poor, or 10 percent of the urban population, last year compared with more than eight million or 13 percent in 1993.
Suharto said poverty was one of the worst manifestations of the gap between economic growth and distribution of wealth.
